extensionDescription.message: Adds the active tab's origin and path to local Computer History so DSH can resume the right work. Metadata only: no page content is ever read.

intro.message: Adds the active tab's origin and path to your local work history so DSH can continue the right project later.

pairingBody.message: Paste the one-time token shown in Computer History → Browser companion.

tokenPlaceholder.message: Paste the token shown once in DSH

portHelp.message: Keep the default unless Computer History reports a different port. The companion only connects to 127.0.0.1.

footnote.message: The pairing token is stored by the browser extension. Computer History stores only its digest and never exposes the token again.

portInvalid.message: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

storedToken.message: A pairing token is stored. Test the connection, or paste a new token to replace it.

savedLocal.message: Saved locally. Browser metadata will be sent to 127.0.0.1:$PORT$.

tokenNeededBody.message: Paste the pairing token shown once in Computer History first.

checkingBody.message: Checking the local Computer History intake…

connectedBody.message: Connected. Computer History accepted this browser companion.

pairingRejectedBody.message: Computer History is reachable, but the token was not accepted. Create a new token in DSH and try again.

offlineBody.message: No Computer History intake is listening on 127.0.0.1:$PORT$. Open DSH and make sure Computer History is running.
